system.description:
This jutsu can be cast even if you cannot normally gain the benefits of a reaction.

You raise your defenses in preparation of being the target of a Finisher. You treat all jutsu with the Finisher keyword as if it was not cast as a Finisher until the end of the current turn. If a jutsu can only be cast as a finisher, you are no longer a valid target, and if there are no other valid targets, the jutsu casting is interrupted and fails.
